title: Quarantining a Device in the Zscaler Admin Console

blocks.text: You can quarantine devices that are determined to be a potential threat in the Zscaler Admin Console. This could occur if a device doesn’t meet security standards, such as running malware, violating company policy, or attempting to use a stolen device. Quarantining a device limits or blocks its access to Zscaler applications.

After you quarantine a device, it can't be re-enrolled unless an admin moves it to the Removed state. The device can't be used to log in again, is not available for soft removal, and is eligible for hard deletion.
Quarantining a device doesn't count against the number of devices in the device limit.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Device Overview.
On the Device Management page, click the User ID of the device you want to quarantine.
From the Actions drop-down menu, click Quarantine.

blocks.text: You can unquarantine a device in the Zscaler Admin Console. The device’s state changes to Removed, and you can use the device to log in to Zscaler Client Connector.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Device Overview.
On the Device Management page, click the User ID of the device you want to unquarantine.
From the Actions drop-down menu, click Unquarantine.
